uid.title: Edit Free Fire UID
uid.description: Fix or clear the Free Fire UID on {name}'s account. Confirm with the player that the new UID is theirs before you save.
uid.hint: Numbers only, up to 15 digits. Leave this blank and use Remove UID to clear it instead.
uid.lockedTitle: This player is in a live event
uid.lockedBody: Their match results are attributed under the UID we hold now. Changing it mid-event can break that link, so only do this if the current UID is wrong.
uid.removeBody: {name} will have no Free Fire UID until they add one. They can still sign in with their in-game name or their email, but not with their UID, and they will not pass any event that requires a UID. The value {uid} becomes free for its real owner.

email.title: Change account email
email.description: Set a new email for {name}. Use this for a player who signed up with the wrong address and is locked out. Verify who they are before you change it.
email.consequenceSignIn: They sign in with the new address straight away, no confirmation email needed.
email.consequenceSessions: {count, plural, =0 {No devices are signed in right now.} one {# signed-in device is signed out.} other {# signed-in devices are signed out.}}
email.consequenceReactivate: The account is reactivated, so a never-verified signup can sign in again.
email.consequenceNotice: Both the old and the new address are emailed about the change.
email.twoFactorTitle: This account has two-factor authentication on
email.twoFactorBody: The second factor is a code sent to the account email, so moving the address would hand it to the new inbox. Saving switches two-factor off and deletes the recovery codes. The player is told by email to turn it back on.

username.title: Change in-game name
username.description: Set a new in-game name for {name}. Use this when the player cannot change it themselves, for example while they are in a live event.
username.hint: Up to 40 characters. It cannot match another account's name, email or Free Fire UID.
username.lockedTitle: This player is in a live event
username.lockedBody: Results already recorded in that event still show their old name until it is over. Only change it now if the current name is wrong.
username.consequenceSignIn: The old name stops working at sign-in. Their email and UID still work.
username.consequenceSessions: Nobody is signed out, so a player in a match is not interrupted.
username.consequenceNotice: The player is emailed that their name changed.
username.failed: Failed to update the in-game name

country.title: Change country
country.description: Set the country on {name}'s account. It decides which announcements they receive and which language they get by default.
country.hint: Pick from the list so this account groups with everyone else from that country.

whatsapp.title: Change WhatsApp number
whatsapp.description: Set the WhatsApp number on {name}'s account. Confirm with the player that the number is theirs before you save.
whatsapp.hint: Include the country code, starting with + or 00. The number on file is hidden on purpose, so type the one the player gave you.
whatsapp.consequenceRecovery: This number can be used to recover the account, so it must belong to the player.
whatsapp.consequenceNotice: The player is emailed that their number changed.
whatsapp.removeBody: {name} will have no WhatsApp number on file, so the number {number} can no longer be used to recover their account or to reach them on WhatsApp.
whatsapp.failed: Failed to update the WhatsApp number

reason.label: Reason
reason.placeholder: Why are you making this change?
reason.hint: Recorded in the audit log with your name, the old value and the new one.
